items.prompt: Please explain what draws you to the academic areas you selected above and how you hope to explore them at Rice University.
items.ru: Обязательное эссе: что привлекает в выбранных предметах и как вы будете их изучать в Rice. До 150 слов.
items.evidence: Please explain what draws you to the academic areas you selected above and how you hope to explore them at Rice University. 150 word limit.

items.prompt: Based upon your exploration of Rice University, what elements of the Rice experience appeal to you?
items.ru: Обязательное эссе: какие стороны учёбы и жизни в Rice вам подходят. До 150 слов.
items.evidence: Based upon your exploration of Rice University, what elements of the Rice experience appeal to you? 150 word limit.

items.prompt: The Residential College System is at the heart of Rice student life and is heavily influenced by the particular cultural traditions and unique life experiences each student brings. What life experiences and/or unique perspectives are you looking forward to sharing with fellow Owls in the residential college system?
items.ru: Один из двух вопросов на выбор: какой опыт вы принесёте в систему резиденций Rice. До 500 слов.
items.evidence: The Residential College System is at the heart of Rice student life and is heavily influenced by the particular cultural traditions and unique life experiences each student brings. items.prompt: Rice is strengthened by its diverse community of learning and discovery that produces leaders and change agents across the spectrum of human endeavor. What perspectives shaped by your background, experiences, upbringing, and/or cultural identity inspire you to join our community of change agents at Rice?
items.ru: Один из двух вопросов на выбор: какие взгляды из вашего опыта побуждают вас присоединиться к сообществу Rice. До 500 слов.
items.evidence: Rice is strengthened by its diverse community of learning and discovery that produces leaders and change agents across the spectrum of human endeavor. items.prompt: Why are you determined to study architecture? Please explain your motivation and describe how your past experiences have led you to apply to the Rice School of Architecture in particular. Have you had an opportunity outside of school-such as an internship, building project, architecture summer program or other experience-that strengthened your interest in the field? If so, please describe how the experience further compels you to pursue a career in architecture.
items.ru: Для Architecture: почему вы хотите изучать архитектуру и как прошлый опыт привёл вас в Rice. До 250 слов.
items.evidence: Why are you determined to study architecture? Have you had an opportunity outside of school-such as an internship, building project, architecture summer program or other experience-that strengthened your interest in the field? If so, please describe how the experience further compels you to pursue a career in architecture. 250 words.

items.prompt: Describe a building, place, or city that you have encountered and found especially compelling. What specifically captured your attention, and why? In your response, reflect on how this experience has shaped your understanding of architecture and the built environment.
items.ru: Для Architecture: опишите здание, место или город, которые вас особенно зацепили, и почему. До 250 слов.
items.evidence: Describe a building, place, or city that you have encountered and found especially compelling. What specifically captured your attention, and why? In your response, reflect on how this experience has shaped your understanding of architecture and the built environment. 250 words.

items.ru: Нужно выбрать изображение для Rice Box и загрузить в Common App или портал Rice.
items.evidence: Rice Box One of Rice's long-standing traditions is "The Box," a question on our application where we ask all of our applicants to share an image of something that appeals to them.

items.ru: Для Architecture нужно портфолио: до 10 страниц без титульной, можно несколько работ на странице.
items.evidence: Content can be up to 10 pages (not including the title page); more than one image or work can be included per page

items.ru: Для Department of Art можно приложить портфолио: до 10 файлов, одна работа на файл.
items.evidence: Content can be up to 10 files; one work per file (details can be included)

items.ru: Для Shepherd School of Music нужны дополнительные материалы по специальности.
items.evidence: Applicants interested in Shepherd School of Music must submit additional materials depending on their area of study.

items.ru: Письмо от школьного консультанта, колледж-консультанта, директора или завуча.
items.evidence: Candidates must submit letters of recommendation from their counselor and two teachers.

items.ru: Две рекомендации от учителей основных предметов; желательно одна по будущей специальности.
items.evidence: The two teacher recommendations serve to highlight the applicant's academic strengths and contributions in the classroom.

items.ru: Можно добавить дополнительное письмо от человека, который хорошо знает ваши успехи.
items.evidence: However, if someone has unique and personal knowledge about an applicant's accomplishments or talents, the applicant may have that individual submit a supplemental recommendation.

items.ru: Интервью рекомендуют, но оно не обязательно и не гарантировано; запросить можно после подачи.
items.evidence: We recommend an interview for first-year applicants, though they are optional and not guaranteed.

items.ru: Международные ученики могут приложить интервью InitialView; оно не обязательно.
items.evidence: International students applying to Rice University may submit interviews from InitialView . Similar to interviews offered directly by Rice, InitialView interviews are optional.

note: Общее эссе и список активностей Common App общие, не внесены. Rice Box — обязательное изображение. Портфолио нужно только Architecture (обязательно) и Art (по желанию).
